## Result

- Skill: design-review
- Review status: approved
- Package members: Release model (release), with its directly affected operational guidance docs/releases/README.md; exact subjects and supporting basis stored.
- Upstream review ID: no new Proposal Review selected for this corrective slice. Explicit user authority corrects integration of the adopted Release direction; the linked earlier proposal is baseline direction, not a retargeted old judgment.
- Review ID and round: design-review-r1, round 1, change 2026-09-10-release-validation-integration.
- Material findings: none.
- Correction targets: none at Design scope.
- Recording status: recorded through targeted batch on successful save.
- Open blockers: none to Design approval; existing failed CI and deployment prerequisites remain unresolved runtime matters.
- Immediate next stage: route-owned Delivery allocation and independent review. This isolated review does not advance activity.
- Claim limitations: exact Design amendment approval only; no implementation correctness, passed CI, fresh Verify, configured remote protection, PR readiness or publication authority.

## Complete-package assessment

The added ordinary-CI section distinguishes three real subjects: authored pending intent, generated candidate package and completed historical publication evidence. It requires checking source/version intent before candidate reliance, rejects missing/contradictory/unknown state, and preserves completed records' recorded-source checks. This resolves the reported subject mismatch without falsely presenting an authored pending record as completed release evidence or supplying an old release's metadata to a new package.

Technical realization is credible: the existing candidate builder already prepares an isolated derived source and archive-based package overlay, then invokes the prepared-candidate release command. Read-only inspection confirms that boundary and the current selector's historical recorded-source invocation. The reported v1.0.0 nine-check candidate success and four failed raw CI checks provide a concrete integration basis, not a waiver or new independently reproduced pass. Composition can use that existing boundary while retaining selected checks and their failure propagation; it needs no new runner or weakened validator.

The actual checked source remains the root identity. Isolated preparation cannot edit the original checkout, and prepared-subject results must identify their distinct subject. Generated sections, archive metadata/index and packed runtime are real check inputs, not invented pass fields. Current package expectations become data derived from the actual tested package, while explicitly historical and incompatible-version cases remain fixed. The existing prohibition on generating executable/test logic is preserved. These constraints prevent making a stale fixture pass by erasing its protection or modifying source during validation.

Local PR preparation is explicitly permitted before merge only for proof. Hosted release still prepares the exact merged source and binds its own candidate to the protected environment approval. The premerge candidate is neither a deployable authorization nor an automatic substitute for the hosted subject. Existing immutability, metadata ordering, public observation, recovery and evidence requirements remain unchanged.

The user-selected zero GitHub approving-review policy is explicit in both affected documents. Required pull requests and CI remain, as do independent recorded engineering assessment and distinct Verify. The release environment remains the one normal publication approval. This is a selected governance-integration correction, not an inference that removing a provider review counter removes engineering review or configures remote protection automatically.

The README accurately presents version intent and notes as authored inputs, with generated metadata/evidence handled by tooling. It preserves separate deployment setup, evidence-ref reading and historical/exceptional operation. No other owner needs a new contract: shared selection still decides applicable checks, while Release specifies how its pending versus historical subjects compose those checks. The original model's clauses, source displacement, decisions and safety boundaries remain coherent with this local extension.

## Acceptance, feasibility and limitations

Representative acceptance intent covers a new stable major version without per-version executable edits; invalid/mismatched intent; builder or selected-check failure; stale metadata; historical validation; untouched original checkout; and the retained approval boundary. Delivery must allocate these real boundaries and fixture regressions. In particular, a passing candidate cannot replace the selected ordinary-CI command evidence, and unchanged historical behavior needs actual protection, not a statement that all pending inputs may bypass validation.

No newly approved deletion, broad check-policy reclassification, publication or remote configuration action follows from this review. The historical preparation report remains original evidence, including its failed checks and then-observed one-review setup; its old observation need not be rewritten to pretend the new policy was already deployed. Current source/setup truth and implementation results belong to their ensuing stages.

## Independence and checks

Original independent Release Design assessor authored none of this amendment, guidance or implementation. Assessed current complete members in the context of prior complete-model reviews, exact delta, primary context, the operational failure report, relevant candidate/selector command boundaries and stored subject identities. No old judgment is reopened or retargeted. No draft Delivery plan is relied upon.

Commands actually used: cat/sed for skill, model/guidance and evidence; git diff for exact amendment; bounded rg of prepare_candidate, release-integrity/prepared-candidate and recorded-source selection; primary context/subject inspect; targeted recording. No runtime candidate build or failing-CI reproduction was executed by this reviewer. Record-store validation and git diff --check follow save and establish structure/hygiene only.
independence_basis: Independent original Release assessor did not author the scoped model/guidance amendment or implementation; assessed complete current affected subjects and real integration boundaries.
